subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Intrahepatic Cholestasis, Fatty Liver, Hepatitis and Asthma

steps.tx: Itching with raised bile acids in late pregnancy without rash is **intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy**. Palms and soles itch worst, especially at night. Stillbirth risk rises with bile acids above one hundred, driving timed delivery. Bile acids at or above 100 micromoles per litre mark the group where stillbirth risk measurably climbs.
steps.say: Intrahepatic cholestasis itches palms and soles with raised bile acids and stillbirth risk.

steps.tx: The bile acid drug easing itch modestly and used first line is **ursodeoxycholic acid**. It improves biochemistry though stillbirth prevention is unproven. Delivery timing, not drugs, is what protects the fetus. Dose is 10 to 15 milligrams per kilogram daily in divided doses, started once other liver causes are excluded.
steps.say: Ursodeoxycholic acid eases cholestasis itch modestly, while delivery timing protects the fetus.

steps.tx: Microvesicular fat infiltration of the liver in late pregnancy causing liver failure is **acute fatty liver** of pregnancy. Hypoglycaemia, coagulopathy and encephalopathy develop rapidly. Immediate delivery after stabilisation is the only treatment. Low glucose with a raised lactate and ammonia separates it from HELLP at the bedside.
steps.say: Acute fatty liver causes liver failure needing immediate delivery after stabilisation.

steps.tx: The hepatitis virus with fulminant course and high maternal mortality in pregnancy is **viral hepatitis E**. In endemic regions it kills up to a fifth of infected pregnant women. Supportive care and delivery planning in liver units are the response. Water borne outbreaks in pregnancy carry maternal death rates near 20 percent in hospital series from endemic regions.
steps.say: Hepatitis E kills up to a fifth of infected pregnant women in endemic regions.

steps.tx: Airways disease usually unchanged or improved in pregnancy, needing inhaler continuation, is **asthma** in pregnancy. Stopping preventers from teratogenicity fear causes more harm than any inhaler. Acute attacks get standard treatment including steroids without hesitation. A third of women improve, a third stay the same, and a third worsen, the rough thirds rule for counselling.
steps.say: Asthma inhalers continue in pregnancy because attacks harm more than any inhaler.

steps.tx: Kidney disease in pregnancy stratifies risk by creatinine and proteinuria before conception, termed **renal disease** counselling. Rising creatinine beyond one forty micromoles worsens prognosis steeply. Superimposed pre-eclampsia is the commonest complication. Dialysis patients face stillbirth rates near 30 percent without intensified surveillance and early delivery planning.
steps.say: Renal disease counselling stratifies risk by creatinine, worsening steeply beyond one forty.

steps.tx: Swansea criteria help separate acute fatty liver from pre-eclampsia and HELLP, a **diagnostic criteria set**. Vomiting, encephalopathy, hypoglycaemia and coagulopathy favour fatty liver. Overlap is real, and delivery treats all three. Six or more of the fourteen Swansea features support the diagnosis in the right clinical setting.
steps.say: Swansea criteria separate fatty liver from HELLP, though delivery treats all three.

steps.tx: Itch without bile acid rise still needs repeat testing because levels lag symptoms, following **repeat testing rule**. Bile acids are repeated weekly while itch persists unexplained. Normal transaminases never exclude cholestasis alone. Transaminases can rise two weeks before bile acids, so a normal first bile acid result is repeated while itch persists.
steps.say: Repeat testing weekly follows itch because bile acids lag symptoms in cholestasis.

steps.tx: After cholestasis, liver tests and bile acids normalise within weeks, confirmed at the **postnatal check**. Persistence suggests underlying liver disease needing referral. Future contraception avoids oestrogen if cholestasis recurs on it. Oestrogen contraception can rekindle the itch, so progestogen only methods are usually advised.
steps.say: Postnatal checks confirm cholestasis resolution, and persistence needs liver referral.
